segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer; Case and Pepito banter about fruit snacks, DOGE checks, and stream technicalities before transitioning to news.

segments.title: No Kings Protests & Trump AI Feces Video
segments.notes: Case and Rick discuss the nationwide No Kings protests (Case attended Glendale with Kasim; Dave Foley spotted); Trump posts AI video on Truth Social depicting himself dumping feces on protesters; Rick defends presidential 'artistic expression.'

segments.title: Gaza Ceasefire Violations & Dropsite News Summary
segments.notes: Case and Rick read Dropsite News rundown: Israeli forces killed 80+ Palestinians since ceasefire began, bulldozer detonated own unexploded ordnance then blamed Hamas, Katz threatens 'yellow line' executions; Trump administration reportedly wants ceasefire to hold but attention span questioned.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Sipan & Fruithead/Gushers Short Film
segments.notes: Case watches UK-only football trailer 'Sipan' (Roy Keane biopic) and a nine-minute Gushers commercial 'Fruithead' starring a strawberry-headed man; debates whether nine-minute runtime qualifies as trailer or short film.

segments.title: Town Hall Monday with Hate Sock & Little Tommy Big Law
segments.notes: Hate Sock and Case's lawyer Little Tommy Big Law field viewer questions via !th command; topics include Hype Train fuel, dino nugget sauces, Hamtaro resurrection theology, John Cronus death hoax, and Hate Sock's hypothetical horror segment; segment ends with musical sign-off.

segments.title: Kendall Walk-Through, Beyblade Update & Raid
segments.notes: Kendall appears with massive Chuck E. Cheese head prop; Case announces Beyblade gold hit, plans four-way Beyblade bet-off for Friday pending betting mechanism; Chet briefly appears twerking; stream ends with raid to Golden Boy.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored broadcast covering No Kings protests, Gaza ceasefire violations, movie trailers, and Town Hall; attended Glendale protest with Kasim; announced Friday Beyblade bet-off.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on; demanded 10,000 miles of fruit tape; bantered about DOGE checks and stream pacing.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Joined for Amongst the Web-style segment; read Dropsite News Gaza summary; claimed CIA recruitment at 16 and high school rap battle history.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Commandeered broadcast during ceasefire discussion; demanded Care Bear Cousins trap beat; freestyled about Care Bears and 'puffing on loud.'

characters.name: Hate Sock
characters.notes: town hall panelist. Joined from sock drawer for Town Hall Monday; responded to all questions with 'dumbass' and 'you wish'; threatened cease-and-desist over mimicry.

characters.name: Little Tommy Big Law
characters.notes: town hall panelist. Case's lawyer billing thousands per appearance; answered food questions (ketchup on everything, non-spicy teriyaki wings); declared Hamtaro devotion.

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through with giant Chuck E. Cheese head prop; computer recently repaired (crashes less); declined to twerk or stream Minesweeper.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Briefly appeared at stream end to demonstrate twerking technique per chat request.

storylines.beat: [1:40:11] Case confirms Beyblade gold hit; plans four-way Beyblade bet-off for Friday pending betting mechanism setup.

lore_notes.fact: Case attended No Kings protest in Glendale with Kasim on Saturday; Dave Foley (Kids in the Hall) was present and posted Kasim on Instagram.
Kendall's computer repaired — crashed once but no longer daily crashes.
Beyblade Tournament betting mechanism still needs configuration for Friday four-way bet-off.
Case cites football injuries preventing effective twerking.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell covers the nationwide No Kings protests and Trump's AI-generated feces video before Rick delivers a Dropsite News briefing on accelerating Gaza ceasefire violations including an Israeli bulldozer self-detonation blamed on Hamas. The broadcast detours through a UK football trailer and a nine-minute Gushers commercial, then convenes Town Hall Monday with Hate Sock and Little Tommy Big Law fielding chaotic viewer questions. Kendall appears with a Chuck E. Cheese head prop, and Case announces a Friday four-way Beyblade bet-off before raiding Golden Boy.
